power_how: 1000 simulated days a scenario and sigma; the truth a model's forecast (v3.1, v3, or their geometric mean) times exp(N(0, sigma)), independent cases; d = |ln(truth / v3)| - |ln(truth / v3.1)| (watts at the points v3.1 puts under 3 W); the sign test on the untied cases; the bootstrap of the mean d with 1000 resamples a day; seed 20261119
test_rule: every head-to-head rule (H1-H5 per arm and group; HP1-HP5 pooled over both arms per group, each case or point once with its own arm's tie, NO DATA unless both arms scored) is decided by the exact two-sided sign test at alpha 0.05 on the untied cases (TOO FEW under 10 untied); the percentile bootstrap 95% interval of the mean d over the cases at 3 W and above (B = 10,000, seeded 'E215|bootstrap|<group>|<arm>|<rule>') and the family check REPORTED beside, never verdicts; the post hoc group (L, S) is scored by the same rules and reported apart in every verdict line
what: every band, tie, threshold and test of E215, before any datum
